h_gate_assessment.finding: The authenticated staging architecture exists and passes locally, but no protected hosted workspace usable by external dry-run raters has been exercised.
The staging runtime has an isolated server entry point, reproducible commands, syntax checks, clean-start behavior, and health checks while the mature public server remains separate.
Issue, redeem, expiry, one-time use, revoke, replace, logout, session reuse, cross-account denial, and recovery are automated; hosted and qualified-human acceptance remain absent.

Desktop and mobile browser automation covers all four sibling critiques, the full seven-dimensional rubric, auxiliary fields, autosave, resume, submission, receipts, and locked state; qualified expert-style walkthrough evidence remains absent.
Autosave, restart and resume, stale-version conflict, idempotent submission, tamper rejection, and duplicate prevention pass deterministically without lost or duplicated accepted scores.

The append-only file-backed event store passes restart, readback, backup, restore, and hash-chain checks, but no dedicated hosted staging database or browser-to-hosted-database rehearsal has been exercised.

Correction, predecessor-linked rerating, withdrawal, and immutable history pass through the runtime state machine; a complete rater-visible correction and withdrawal walkthrough plus operator response is still required.
Two isolated browser contexts, hidden peer identity and metadata, cross-account write denial, and direct-object access denial are retained in the exact-head evidence.

Adjudication handoff, predecessor-linked rerating, immutable initial ratings, and explicit unresolved closure pass; closed-without-rerating and all three paths through the complete operator/adjudicator interface remain to be retained.
The support and incident runbook exists, but no named tabletop execution record demonstrates recovery from a selected incident.
No two qualified human synthetic dry runs have occurred.
No operations-owner readiness signature citing complete H-01 through H-11 evidence exists.

limitations: The passing CI run is evidence about an automated synthetic local runtime, not a qualified human usability study.
No dedicated hosted staging database or protected preview deployment was exercised.
No person is selected merely by appearing in an internal candidate slate.
No email, invitation, assignment, honorarium promise, payment, or real rating is authorized by this record.
The PR remains draft and unmerged.
